title: dHyperCas12a enables multiplexed CRISPRi screens.
model: A549, dCas12a CRISPRi pre-crRNA array fitness library (four repressors)
contrast: Day 21 vs day 5 per repressor, paired by transduction (3 vs 3); primary dHyperLbCas12a-KRAB
paper_method: DESeq2 time course and MAGeCK MLE
paper_calls: 31 depleted genes (dHyperLbCas12a-KRAB), 5, 1 and 0 for the other repressors (MAGeCK MLE Wald FDR 0.05)
barcs_calls: 46 genes at FDR 0.10 for dHyperLbCas12a-KRAB (28 depleted, all paper calls); 3, 8 and 0 for the other repressors
named_hits: 6/6 of the paper's top depleted genes at FDR 0.10 (RPL34 #1, SMC2 #2, XPO1 #3, MDM4 #5, SNRPE #7, RPS20 #11 among depleted genes, by p)
verdict: BARCS reproduces the repressor ranking (dHyperLbCas12a-KRAB far ahead, dEnAsCas12a-4xSID with no hits) and every BARCS depletion call is a paper call; lists are a little shorter after control calibration (12% raw control rate) and with the day-21 vs day-5 endpoint instead of the time course.
